verdict.rationale: The SDK documents real-time token streaming through `include_partial_messages`/`includePartialMessages`, and it exposes agent activity as an async message stream plus hook callbacks that fire on events such as tool calls. That covers the core of the story. However, streaming intermediate tool-call and step events to a UI is only implied by the message iterator and hooks, not explicitly documented as a UI event stream. missing for 10: explicit documentation of streamed tool-call/step event types, a worked example of piping events to a UI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time

citations.quote: To enable streaming, set `include_partial_messages` (Python) or `includePartialMessages` (TypeScript) to `true` in your options.
